header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Satram Sonani Bheel advocate for the applicant.
Mr. Yar Muhammad Mangrio advocate for respondent
body: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the respondent No.3 and learned D.P.G.

Learned D.P.G has pointed out that the offence, for which respondent No.3 wants to register F.I.R from perusal of paragraph No.2 of application filed under section 22-A and B Cr.P.C and Medico-Legal certificate of injured, is of noncognizable offence, for which no F.I.R can be registered, therefore, he does not support the impugned order. Record reveals that the allegations leveled in application filed before Justice of Peace are of non-cognizable offence, therefore, impugned order dated 17-10-2026 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge-I/Ex-Officio Justice of Peace, Mirpurkhas, in Criminal Misc. Application No. 1733/ 2026 is hereby set aside, leaving the respondent No.3 at liberty to file a Direct Complaint, if so advised. The instant Criminal Misc. Application is disposed of in above terms.
